overview.description: The American Century Core Plus Income ETF (ABND) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. MUSI seeks to provide a high level of current income via an actively managed broad-based, global bond portfolio without a specific target duration. ABND was launched on Jun 29, 2021 and is issued by American Century Investments.
